section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the study, including the development of the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS), and the application of the Family subscale of the Body Acceptance by Others Scale (BAOS), the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and the Intuitive Eating Scale (IES). It also describes how Body Mass Index (BMI) was calculated from self-reported height and weight. A pilot group of 43 college students (12 men, 31 women, mean age = 26.40) was used to refine the CEMS items for clarity.
